finding.summary: This means that you can never lookup (by instance) the activeTab in the list of tabs. Use, the same instance instead (also results in less code).

label: real_issue
label_reason: A human reviewer raised this in microsoft/vscode#131998 (merged 2021-09-02), and a later commit in the PR changes the file.
notes: Hand-picked with Claude Code (PMAT-310): https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/131998. TypeScript: the active tab is a separate object, so it can never be found in the list by instance. Human reviewers are not perfect ground truth, and they give no severity, so any severity counts.
